finding_key: packages/cli/src/commands/login.ts::the usable oauth url is now printed only when `open()` throws, so a headless/no-browser environment can be left with no way to continue
evidence: Verified at packages/cli/src/commands/login.ts:73–90: the "Opening browser" line prints a nonce-less URL, and the full nonce-carrying oauthUrl is printed only in the catch around `await open(oauthUrl)`. The `open` package with default wait:false resolves once the opener child is spawned and does not reject when xdg-open later fails to surface a browser (SSH/headless/container), so those environments never see the usable URL and hit the 30s timeout. The nonce-less URL that is printed cannot complete the flow either: the listener (login.ts:263–271) rejects a nonce-less callback unless --allow-unbound-callback is set. This regresses the headless copy-paste path the design doc explicitly promises.
